newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market strong in bullish phase.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market strong in bullish phase.

text.p: Three independent indices gauging the performance of Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market touched record highs on Friday when blue chips climbed in a buying mood which has stayed strong throughout the week.

The VAB-RA all-share index, computed by Vanguard securities, moved 4.3 percent ahead from Thursday to 5,654.6 points and BIG-OTC, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group, jumped by 4.5 percent to 4,528.29. Creditanstalt Securities' CAS-RQ went up by 4.37 percent to 1,027 points.

Markert operators said foreign, as well as local investors continued to focus on high-caps, mainly oil refineries and cement makers. They said the market was in for further pick-up at least in the early days of next week.
Petrobrazi oil refinery, an investor attraction, closed 2,000 lei firmer at 55,000, while Arpechim, another oil refinery, ended 5,500 lei stronger at 47,000.
Cement maker Romcim lost 14,000 lei in late trading, closing at 118,000.
Friday session's turnover was 24.3 billion lei, some four billion down from the previous day, with volume also slipping to 3.9 million shares from 6.1 million due to thin supply.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CRAS02 and CRAS03. ($=7,102 lei)
